title: 第九十七章七彩谷主的提醒第九十六章凶险的卦象
content_zh:
第九十七章，七彩谷主的提醒！
密室内。
秦风没有半点犹豫，将刚刚收起来的信封拿了出来。
毕竟，他是也人，也有着好奇心，只是这事太过蹊跷，所以秦风不敢让太多人知道信中内容。
然而，就在秦风将信封打开，准备目睹里面的内容时，却不由傻眼。
因为信纸上没有一个字。
只是一张空白的纸罢了。
这让秦风不由呢喃道：“搞笑吧？难道这位七彩谷主是在玩我？？”
“可恶！！”
就在秦风蹙眉，准备将信纸给揉成一团时，他脑海一亮，似乎想到了什么，于是连忙释放体内灵气，灌入信纸之中。
很快，信纸竟真的发生了变化。
但依旧没有文字出现，而是释放了一股灵气，直接没入了秦风脑海里。
这突如其来的变故，让秦风始料未及，甚至都没有任何防备。
就在他觉得自己中了什么圈套时，脑海里竟响起了一道苍老之声。
“小家伙，想不到你竟如此迫不及待的打开了信纸。”
“看来，你还是很有好奇心的嘛，就不怕这是老夫给你设下的坑？？”
闻言此声，秦风只感觉十分陌生，但还是猜到了声音主人的身份，一想到和自己说话的会是七彩谷主时，秦风强压内心激动道：“前辈名声在外，悬壶济世，从不胡乱杀生。”
“晚辈与您无冤无仇，甚至都未曾见过，您又岂会害我？？”
“呵呵~”
“小子，别那么天真。”

“名声在外，那都是自己给的。”
“既然你打开了信纸，那就问出你的疑惑吧，你只有一炷香时间。”
“等时间一到，信纸变回化为灰烬。”
七彩谷主的声音再次响起道。
“敢问前辈，为何要我三年后前往七彩谷一聚？”
秦风直奔主题道。
“因为现在的你，还不够资格来七彩谷。”
“三年后，你已经在皇家学院有所成长了，自然就能来七彩谷了。”
七彩谷主也立马回应道。
听到此话，秦风眉头紧蹙道：“前辈就如此断定，我能活到三年以后么？想必您也清楚，晚辈现在的处境吧？”
“呵呵~”
“自然清楚，你与龙家的恩怨，乃是你命中一劫。”
“这一劫对你十分重要，非外人所能参与的。”
“但，你与龙家有着截然不同的命运。”
“所以，老夫相信你一定能够活到三年以后。”
content_en:
Chapter 97, Colorful Valley Master’s reminder!
In the secret room.
Qin Feng didn't hesitate at all and took out the envelope he had just put away.
After all, he is a human being and has curiosity, but this matter is too strange, so Qin Feng does not dare to let too many people know the content of the letter.
However, just when Qin Feng opened the envelope and prepared to see the contents inside, he couldn't help but be dumbfounded.
Because there is not a word on the letter.
It's just a blank piece of paper.
This made Qin Feng couldn't help but murmur: "Isn't it funny? Is this Colorful Valley Master playing with me?"
"Damn it!!"
Just when Qin Feng frowned and was about to crumple the letter into a ball, his mind suddenly lit up and he seemed to have thought of something, so he quickly released the spiritual energy in his body and poured it into the letter.
Soon, the letter paper actually changed.
But still no words appeared, but a burst of spiritual energy was released, directly entering Qin Feng's mind.
This sudden change caught Qin Feng by surprise and he didn't even have any precautions.
Just when he thought he had fallen into a trap, an old voice sounded in his mind.
"Little guy, I didn't expect you to be so eager to open the letter."
"It seems that you are still very curious. Aren't you afraid that this is a trap set by me?"
Hearing this voice, Qin Feng felt very strange, but he still guessed the identity of the owner of the voice. When he thought that the person talking to him would be the owner of the colorful valley, Qin Feng suppressed his inner excitement and said: "Senior has a good reputation, hanging pots to help the world, and never killing indiscriminately."
"This junior has no enmity or enmity with you. I have never even met you. How could you harm me?"
"Haha~"
"Boy, don't be so naive."
"The reputation you have is all given by yourself."
"Since you have opened the letter, then ask your doubts. You only have one stick of incense time."
"When the time comes, the letter will turn into ashes."
The Colorful Valley Master's voice sounded again.
"I dare to ask, senior, why do you want me to go to Colorful Valley for a reunion in three years?"
Qin Feng went straight to the topic.
"Because you are not qualified to come to Colorful Valley now."
"Three years later, you have grown up in the Royal Academy, and you will naturally be able to come to Colorful Valley."
The owner of Colorful Valley also responded immediately.
Hearing this, Qin Feng frowned and said: "Senior has concluded like this, can I live until three years later? You must also know the current situation of this junior, right?"
"Haha~"
"Of course it is clear that your grudge with the Long family is your fate."
"This calamity is very important to you and cannot be participated by outsiders."
"But, you and the Long family have completely different fates."
"So, I believe you will be able to live until three years later."
